requirement: Options exposure must distinguish underlying USD market value from contract-scaled Greeks and reject unsupported American exercise assumptions.

failure_case.observed_message: only European option style is supported
failure_case.method: Direct local existing option_price call; no strategy or campaign execution.

finding: Bounded checks pass: underlying long-only exposure and execution costs reconcile; American style explicitly rejects. Selected ETF run contains no option positions or Greeks and cannot substantiate options portfolio or hedge acceptance.
limitations: Synthetic ETF-only run, 43 rows from 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-01; no six-month history, OOS or actual 30-day simulation evidence.
No option chain, contract inventory, expiry/assignment events, portfolio Greeks or hedge effectiveness in returned manifest. Missing Greeks are unknown, not zero.
Local current-source rejection is not proof of installed HTTP options endpoint behavior; no new campaign or broker interaction.
Manifest artifact hashes inspected but bundles not downloaded or independently rehashed; git_commit is null.
M16, M21 and final-release gates remain unresolved; no strategy eligibility or professional approval.
recommendation: Retain European-only research boundary. Require a separately authorized option-position fixture with signed contracts, multipliers, per-unit Greek conventions, expiry events and hedge attribution before options portfolio acceptance.
